android.desc:
Libra tracks your daily weight changes and displays them in a beautiful interactive chart

• It's fun to enter your data every day
• Scroll through your history in smooth dynamic charts
• Quickly get analysis based on measurements like BMI and body composition
• Set goals planning estimate results
• Share your chart with your friends
• Keep your data secure in the Libra Cloud
• Synchronize all of your devices
• Connect your Withings scale to get immediate updates

Supporting Libra is cheaper than fast food!
Remove ads and see your friend's unlimited charts for a single € (or your equivalent currency) per month.

quotes.text:
It's hard to tell from the screenshots if you track weight or not, but if you do I highly recommend doing a similar weighted-average system as Libra[1]. Not a lot of apps do this and it's pretty critical to tracking actual weight loss over time. It's based on the thoughts in [2].

[1] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.cachapa.libra&hl=en

[2] http://www.fourmilab.ch/hackdiet/www/hackdiet.html
